verdict.rationale: v0's docs claim the API gives 'programmatic access to all of v0's capabilities' including chat, code generation, project management and deployment (v0-docs-4), and the SDK examples show chat creation and streaming (v0-gh-1, v0-gh-2), plus GitHub import via API (v0-docs-37). However, this is a vendor claim without independent corroboration, and several UI-only features (Figma/screenshot cloning, visual style controls, iOS app, one-click GitHub PR/CI management) are not shown to have API equivalents. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of full API-UI parity, and explicit API support for design-import/visual-editing/mobile features that exist in the UI.
